Special thanks to Simon Wellesley-Miller who originally wrote this course as a script for NHS-R Community

## Course Overview

::: incremental
- a lot of intermediate data wrangling
- this course assumes a basic level of knowledge of R and dpylr
- it is expected that you are at least familiar with the contents of the NHS-R Introduction to R and R Studio course
- in this tutorial we will be using modern `|>` pipes, these have most of the functionality of the old pipes `%>%` if you prefer to use those
:::

## Agenda - part 1 3.5 hours

Chapter overview

- Loading libraries
- Exploring functions
- Altering functions
- Alternative joins
- Count functions
- Fancy filtering
- Conditionals
- Subtotals (using group and mutate)

## Agenda - part 2 3.5 hours

- Rowwise
- Pivotting
- Rolling functions
- Row numbers and dates
- Grouping by dates
- Strings
- Factors
- Dynamic text
- SPC
- Functions
- Loops

## End session
